### Data Attributes {#dialog-data-attributes}

| Attribute                                                 | Applied when                                           | Purpose                                                                      |
| --------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| data-slot="root"                                          | Always                                                 | Stable root slot selector for the dialog container.                          |
| data-slot="mask"                                          | When the dialog is visible                             | Stable backdrop selector for mask styling.                                   |
| data-slot="header" / "header-content" / "title-container" | When the default header is rendered                    | Stable selectors for header layout and spacing.                              |
| data-slot="title" / "subtitle"                            | When header and subheader content are present          | Stable selectors for dialog copy styling.                                    |
| data-slot="sign-icon"                                     | `showVariantSign` is `true`                            | Stable selector for the variant sign treatment.                              |
| data-slot="content"                                       | When `contentSlot` or `children` render body content   | Stable selector for the main dialog content region.                          |
| data-slot="footer" / "footer-actions"                     | When `footerActions` renders the default footer layout | Stable selectors for footer spacing and action alignment.                    |
| data-variant / data-header-type / data-mask-variant       | Always                                                 | Product styling hooks for dialog tone, header treatment, and mask treatment. |
| data-backdrop-hidden / data-mask-blur                     | When the corresponding visual prop is enabled          | Mask styling hooks for transparent and blurred backdrops.                    |
